question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row facing north. C sits second to the right of B. Only four people sit between C and A. X sits second to the left of A. Only one person sits between A and Y. Z sits to the immediate right of Y. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
Given: A certain number of people are sitting in a row facing north. 

1) C sits second to the right of B. 

2) Only four people sit between C and A. 

3) X sits second to the left of A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cf6ce041548e659909d5f7fe1495eec7c4f5dde5bbf1b7a59c2c30f23e778b0.png] 

4) Only one person sits between A and Y. 

5) Z sits to the immediate right of Y. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1867988178ae98060c8ef775a9a6d0c5090a54f80132241e20f147a1fbb2af4c.png] 

If no other person is sitting in the row, 

Then, there is '11' persons seated in the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
